title: Logix debug configuration, version 1
description:
A debug configuration file: which nets the debugger reads and drives, how
it reaches the host and which clock it runs on.

clock.description:
The clock the debugger and its UART run on: a top-level input port of
the design, such as sys_clk. Every watched and driven net must be on
it.

clock_mhz.description:
The clock's frequency in MHz. Needed only when the clock port isn't
on the board's clock pin, whose frequency the catalog gives.

uplink.description:
How the debugger reaches the host: a UART, named as a resource of the
board, or by its pins.

drive.description:
Nets the host can drive: take them over from the design, or drive
them alone, and release them.

Uplink.description: The link to the host: give resource, or tx and rx.

kind.description: The kind of link: uart, the only one in version 1.

resource.description:
The board's UART, by its resource name in the catalog (get_catalog's
resources), such as uart: the debugger uses its tx and rx pins.

tx.description:
Instead of resource, the FPGA pin the debugger transmits on, such as
a PMOD pin wired to a USB serial adapter's RX.

rx.description: Instead of resource, the FPGA pin the debugger receives on.

name.description: The host's name for it. Defaults to the net's path.

net.description: A one-bit net, named as for watch. Give net or bus.

bus.description:
A net of two bits or more, or a list of one-bit nets combined into a
bus, as for watch; a list's nets are driven and released together.
Give net or bus.

mode.description:
override: the debugger can take over a net the design drives, and
release it back. register: the debugger always drives it. Defaults
to override.

Bus.description: A bus: one net, or a list of one-bit nets and pins combined.

name.description: The host's name for it. Defaults to the net's path.

net.description:
A one-bit net, by its instance path from the top module, starting
with the top module's name, such as main.u_ctrl.busy, or main.blink
for a net in the top module itself. Give net or bus.

bus.description:
A net of two bits or more, named as for net, such as
main.u_ctrl.state; or a list of one-bit nets and pins combined into one bus,
such as ["pin.21", "pin.20", "pin.19", "pin.18"], the first the most
significant, as in a Verilog concatenation (a list needs a name).
Give net or bus.

format.description:
How hosts such as the debug panel show its value at first: hex, dec
or bin. Omitted means bin for one bit and hex for more.

ValueFormat.description: How a watched value is shown.
